source.title: Transformed CNNs: recasting pre-trained convolutional layers with self-attention
source.authors: Stéphane d'Ascoli; Levent Sagun; G. Biroli; Ari S. Morcos

record.file_problem: none; the full paper text, including supplementary sections, is present.
record.tranche_reason: The paper explicitly compares AdamW and SGD for fine-tuning T-CNNs and says SGD gives worse results, bearing on the adaptive-optimizer version in a specific setting.
record.gate_note: The paper does not test random-label fitting, interpolation thresholds, fully connected image classifiers, dropout, magnitude-aware sharpness, or memorized-example removal. Its ImageNet-C/A/R robustness results are out-of-distribution evaluations and are not rows for this claim. The reported ImageNet-1k test accuracies and train/test dynamics concern the claim's subject but do not measure a listed version's defining behavior.
record.test_reason: The authors report their own SGD-versus-AdamW comparison when fine-tuning ImageNet classifiers containing self-attention layers. This tests V4 in a new setting, although only a qualitative outcome is reported.
record.authors_conclusion: The record's paraphrase is accurate. The authors conclude that initializing self-attention from pretrained convolutions can improve accuracy and robustness with limited additional training, and that intermediate reparameterization can improve the speed-performance tradeoff. They separately report worse fine-tuning results with SGD than AdamW.
record.recipe_differences: The paper fine-tunes pretrained CNNs after replacing some convolutions with gated positional self-attention; it does not reproduce the original studies' procedures. Its optimizer comparison is a qualitative statement about its own setup.
record.method_sensitivity: The paper states that SGD gave worse results than AdamW in its fine-tuning setup. It also reports that outcomes vary with learning rate and reparameterization timing, but these findings do not test a listed claim version.

fits_no_version.finding: Transformed CNNs improve ImageNet validation accuracy and robustness over their starting CNNs and improve accuracy over fine-tuning controls without self-attention.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Replacing late convolutions with initialized self-attention and fine-tuning can improve ImageNet classification and robustness.

fits_no_version.finding: Measured training accuracy is below test accuracy during heavily augmented fine-tuning.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Training-time augmentation can make measured training accuracy lower than test accuracy.

fits_no_version.finding: Intermediate reparameterization can outperform training the hybrid architecture from scratch.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Learning convolutional representations before introducing self-attention can improve the final accuracy and training-time tradeoff.

record.problems: The optimizer comparison is qualitative and lacks a separately reported numerical value or uncertainty. The paper does not report results on random labels or measure the train-test error gap for its optimizer comparison.
record.rows_left_out: No qualifying rows were extracted: the quantitative accuracy comparisons concern transformed architectures and ImageNet evaluation, not a listed version's defining measure. Robustness benchmark outcomes are out-of-distribution evaluations.

missing.what: Add the qualitative optimizer comparison: SGD produced worse results than AdamW during T-CNN fine-tuning. Neither accuracy values nor the SGD tuning protocol are supplied; do not infer either from the architecture-comparison tables.

record.verdict_notes: The qualitative optimizer result supports a setting-specific qualification, not a general reversal of V4's 'often' claim. Table 3 changes architecture, training duration, resolution, or optimizer handling across conditions and does not provide a controlled numerical SGD-versus-AdamW comparison.

relationships.condition: Fine-tuning pretrained CNNs reparameterized to include self-attention on ImageNet.
relationships.reason: Based on text only, with no extracted row: section 3 reports worse results with SGD than AdamW. This qualifies the optimizer pattern in this setting; numerical differences and comparative tuning details are unavailable.
relationships.display_finding: AdamW reportedly outperformed SGD, but the result remains unverified and numerical differences and comparative tuning details were unavailable.

source_check.scope: Only the listed rows, labels and statements were checked; presence is not whole-study approval.
